description: Dataset for Finding Equivalence of Layout Independent Water Distribution Network for Expansion/Reorganization Using Nonlinear Multi-Port Thevenin Theorem is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Raman Balireddy, Anjan Chakravorty (1Department of Electrical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Madras, Chennai, India.). This file consists all the data used in the manuscript " Finding Equivalence of Layout Independent Water Distribution Network for Expansion/Reorganization Using Nonlinear Multi-Port Thevenin Theorem ". Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
